I’m deleting it from my phone, seeing as what I paid for in the past no longer works and I’m required to pay more for something I don’t want. 

Update: I recieved a response to my review from the developer answering a question I didnt ask and offering an option that doesnt work. I still cannot access the classic workouts that I paid for.
